OFF-PATH: the seed-dependent route χ_eff = 6 b₃ (demoted, D-009), which returns 144 only at the retired seed. The adopted K3 reading is χ_eff = 2 × Σχ(K3) = 48n, 144 at n = 3.

The steps above follow the off-path route 6 b₃.
chi_eff.topology_connection: OFF-PATH (seed-dependent route, demoted): linear scaling from b₃ via G₂ holonomy constraint; it returns 144 only at the retired seed b₃ = 24.
